round.heading: Warm-up

keypad.label: Number keys
coins.label: {count} coins
gate.heading: Grown-ups only

toast.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
error.heading: Oops! A dragon sneezed.

parent.heading: Grown-ups
parent.keepers.intro: Up to four children can play on this device. Each has their own dragons, progress and settings.
parent.keepers.none: No keepers yet. Add one to start.
parent.keepers.removeBody: This deletes {name}'s dragons, progress and settings on this device. Save a backup first if you may want them back.
parent.keepers.removeFailed: Could not remove {name}. Nothing else changed. Try again.
parent.settings.none: Add a keeper to change their settings.
parent.settings.voiceSample: Fifty-six divided by seven equals eight.
parent.settings.noVoice: This device has no built-in English voice, so the read-aloud button is hidden. Dragon Valley only uses voices that work offline on the device itself, so no text ever leaves it. Installing an English voice in the system settings makes the button appear.
parent.settings.failed: That setting could not be saved, so nothing changed. Try again.
parent.data.backupIntro: A backup file holds one keeper: name, picture, progress and settings. Keep it somewhere safe; you can load it here or on another device.
parent.data.exported: Backup of {name} saved as a file.
parent.data.exportFailed: {name}'s latest progress is not saved yet, so a backup now could miss something. Fix the save first, then try again.
parent.data.importFailed: That file is not a Dragon Valley backup this version can load. Nothing was changed.
parent.data.importConfirmBody: {name}'s current dragons, progress and settings on this device are replaced by the ones in the file.
parent.data.resetBody: This erases {name}'s dragons and progress on this device. Settings stay. It cannot be undone.
parent.data.persisted: The browser has promised to keep saved progress.
parent.data.notPersisted: The browser may clear saved progress if the device runs low on space. Backups keep it safe.
parent.data.persistUnknown: This browser does not say whether it keeps saved progress.
parent.data.persist: Ask the browser to keep progress
parent.offline.heading: Play without internet
parent.offline.intro: Installing copies the whole game to this device, so it also works with no connection. Saved progress is separate and stays either way.
parent.offline.ready: Installed. Dragon Valley works offline on this device.
parent.offline.missing: Not installed for offline play yet.
parent.offline.failed: Installation did not finish ({code}). Nothing was changed. Try again.
parent.offline.unavailable: This browser cannot install Dragon Valley for offline play. A recent browser on a secure (https) page can.
parent.offline.updateReady: An update was downloaded. It starts the next time Dragon Valley opens, never in the middle of a game.
parent.about.privacy: Dragon Valley has no accounts, ads, purchases, links out or tracking. Progress stays on this device.
parent.about.font: Text uses DV Reading, a subset of the Andika font by SIL Global, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
recovery.heading: Saved data needs a grown-up
recovery.family: The list of keepers on this device could not be opened.
recovery.game: {name}'s saved game could not be opened.
recovery.unavailable: The browser is not letting Dragon Valley use its storage. Private windows often do this.
recovery.export: Save the stored data to a file
recovery.previous: Go back to the previous copy
recovery.resetBody: This cannot be undone. Save the stored data to a file first if you might need it.
recovery.failed: That did not work, so the saved data was not changed.
